units.title: Decompose evidence and causal-inference variants
units.objective: Freeze sources and independently decompose P01, P02, P03, P04, and P14 without normalizing their method-owned semantics.

included: P01 systematic review, P02 policy RCT, P03 difference-in-differences, P04 fsQCA, and P14 theory-testing Process Tracing
Per-method source freeze, three-level records, typed connections, and uncertainty accounting
excluded: Collision scoring, equivalence verdicts, coverage claims, shared vocabulary changes, implementation, and edits outside assigned method directories

outputs: Five exclusive method directories, each containing frame.yaml, sources.md, method_records.yaml, connections.yaml, and uncertainty.yaml

acceptance.criterion: All five exact variants are frozen before decomposition with edition/section pins, explicit exclusions, applicability boundaries, and source-scope cautions resolved or retained as uncertainty.
evidence_required: Source verification links or durable references
acceptance.negative_control: Reject a frame that treats an existing product representation, catalog label, or adjacent method as methodological authority.

acceptance.criterion: Every method has complete three-level records, typed topology including nonlinearity and prohibited transitions, and exact uncertainty accounting without cross-method normalization.
acceptance.negative_control: Reject missing operations hidden by broad phases or execution actions represented as method-owned analytical warrants.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One canonical registry claim bound to this exact unit and only its exclusive method paths.

units.title: Decompose measurement, forecasting, and simulation variants
units.objective: Freeze sources and independently decompose P06, P07, P08, and P09 while preserving measurement, prediction, and generated-model evidence boundaries.

included: P06 probability survey, P07 supervised quantitative text measurement, P08 probabilistic forecasting, and P09 agent-based policy simulation
Per-method source freeze, three-level records, typed connections, and uncertainty accounting
excluded: Collision scoring, empirical runs, model fitting, coverage claims, shared vocabulary changes, implementation, and edits outside assigned method directories

outputs: Four exclusive method directories, each containing frame.yaml, sources.md, method_records.yaml, connections.yaml, and uncertainty.yaml

acceptance.criterion: All four exact variants are frozen with adequate conduct authorities, including an experiment-design authority beyond ODD for P09 and an explicit construct-validity boundary for P07.
evidence_required: Source verification links or durable references
acceptance.negative_control: Reject a source set that uses an implementation, benchmark, or reporting format as the sole conduct authority.

acceptance.criterion: Every method has complete three-level records, typed topology, origin-preserving handoffs, and exact uncertainty accounting without treating prediction, measurement, or simulation as causal evidence.
acceptance.negative_control: Reject a connection that silently changes simulated or derived information into observed real-world evidence.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One canonical registry claim bound to this exact unit and only its exclusive method paths.

units.title: Decompose interpretive, decision, elicitation, and integration variants
units.objective: Freeze sources and independently decompose P05, P10, P11, P12, and P13 while preserving human authority, disagreement, and meta-inference boundaries.

included: P05 constructivist grounded theory, P10 Robust Decision Making, P11 Green Book appraisal, P12 policy Delphi, and P13 convergent mixed methods
Per-method source freeze, three-level records, typed connections, and uncertainty accounting
excluded: Collision scoring, expert elicitation, policy recommendation, coverage claims, shared vocabulary changes, implementation, and edits outside assigned method directories

outputs: Five exclusive method directories, each containing frame.yaml, sources.md, method_records.yaml, connections.yaml, and uncertainty.yaml

acceptance.criterion: All five variants are frozen with exact conduct sources, method-specific applicability, and separate performer, judgment, review, recommendation, value, and decision authorities where applicable.
evidence_required: Source verification links or durable references
acceptance.negative_control: Reject a frame that lets consensus equal truth, merges a recommendation with an accountable decision, or flattens qualitative and quantitative strand warrants.

acceptance.criterion: Every method has complete three-level records, feedback-capable typed topology, reflexive or disagreement traces where required, and exact uncertainty accounting.
acceptance.negative_control: Reject a linearized record that removes theoretical-sampling, adaptive-strategy, Delphi-feedback, appraisal-return, or divergence-disposition loops.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One canonical registry claim bound to this exact unit and only its exclusive method paths.

units.title: Integrate and validate the 14-method decomposition
units.objective: Validate the exact adopted denominator and format across accepted lane outputs without normalizing semantics or beginning collision analysis.

included: Manifest all 14 accepted method directories and validate identifiers, source freezes, required artifacts, three-level fields, typed connections, uncertainty, and phase boundaries
Return defects to the owning research lane with exact evidence
excluded: Editing method-owned records, collision candidates or verdicts, adjudication, coverage or automation calculations, schema adoption, infrastructure, and product implementation

outputs: portfolio_manifest.yaml listing the exact 14 submitted method revisions
integration_report.md with pass/fail findings and owner-returned defects
validation_report.json with deterministic checks and explicit phase-boundary failures

dependencies.rationale: All five evidence and causal-inference method records must be accepted at exact revisions.
All four measurement, forecasting, and simulation records must be accepted at exact revisions.
All five interpretive, decision, elicitation, and integration records must be accepted at exact revisions.

acceptance.criterion: The manifest contains exactly P01 through P14 once each and binds every method to an accepted submitted revision and its five required artifacts.
acceptance.negative_control: Reject duplicate, missing, extra, unpinned, or cross-owned method artifacts.

acceptance.criterion: All records and connections conform to the accepted discovery instrument, uncertainties remain explicit, and no artifact claims a collision, promotion, coverage result, shared schema, or implementation authorization.
acceptance.negative_control: Inject an out-of-scope collision or coverage claim and require validation to fail.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One canonical registry claim after all three hard dependency gates report accepted exact revisions.
